skill.summary: Reviews pitch decks and provides investor-ready feedback with scoring

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Pitch Deck Reviewer skill.
- Provides VC-style reviews of pitch decks with section-by-section scoring (1–10) and actionable investor-grade feedback.
- Structured, tabular output includes strengths, critical fixes, "nice to have" improvements, and anticipated investor questions.
- Emphasizes brutal honesty, specificity, and comparisons to industry standards.
- Highlights issues like lack of competition slides or inadequate market sizing.
- Includes links to related tools for revenue calculation, proposal generation, and industry context.
